QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves THREADING_C, THREADING_ALT and THREADING_PTHREAD commented out, so a default build defines none of them, which covers both threading macros.
